lines: #Before you buy it, *wait.*
Twenty four *hours.*
That's it. That's the whole *rule.*
#Most purchases aren't *decisions.*
They're *feelings.*
Bored? Buy something. Stressed? Buy *something.*
Saw an ad at midnight? Add to *cart.*
The apps know this. That's why buying is just *one* tap.
No time to think. No time to *ask* if you need it.
#Waiting one day breaks the *spell.*
Half the time, tomorrow you won't even *remember* what you wanted.
The other half, you'll realise you didn't really *need* it.
And if you still want it after a day? Fine. Now it's a *choice.*
#That pause is where your money *stays* yours.
It feels small. But it adds up to *hundreds.*
Then *thousands.*
Money that could become a cushion. A *trip.* A future.
Try it for one month. Every single *purchase.*
You'll be shocked how much you *keep.*
#You don't need more willpower. You need a *pause.*
Next time you're about to tap buy, *stop.*
Close the app. Wait a day.
Your future self will *thank* you.
end: Follow for your daily push at 7am & 7pm.
